int.text: Argh -- he's regenerating again! We've got to stop him!
This is great! The Dark Energon is breaking down his armor!
Our weapons aren't doing ANYTHING to him!

fra.text: Nos armes ne lui font absolument AUCUN effet !

int.text: Look at that! The corruption's HURTING him!

fra.text: Regardez ça ! La corruption le RONGE !

int.text: Uh...all hail Megatron!
Watch out for those rockets!
You think he survived all that?

fra.text: Vous croyez qu'il a survécu à ça !?

int.text: Uhhh, Megatron?  I don't think that's gonna be a problem.
Weapons engaging?! I thought we had this guy beat!
A battery full of energon just came up out of the floor. ...Is that normal?

fra.text: Une batterie d'énergon vient de sortir du sol... C'est normal, ça ?

int.text: Hey look! There's another battery!
He's getting back up?!?!?  What do we do now?
How're we supposed to get through that armor plating?
I thought you said his power was drained! He's got even more now than he did to begin with!
He's drawing energy from Cybertron's core!

fra.text: Il tire son énergie du noyau de Cybertron !

int.text: Decepticons -- we must move quickly! Use Dark Energon on the core battery!
The great Omega Supreme is vulnerable at last! Decepticons -- ATTACK!
Omega Supreme is vulnerable now!  Finish him!
Now! While the Dark Energon has corrupted Omega Supreme's systems -- OPEN FIRE!
I, Megatron, have defeated Omega Supreme!
Stop whining and start shooting, Breakdown!
War Cry 3
As long as there is enough left to open the Omega Gate--I care not.
What are you waiting for? Use the Dark Energon on it!
Stop wasting time and attack Omega's turrets!

fra.text: Cesse de perdre du temps et attaque les tourelles d'Omega !

int.text: What amazing power!  I must have it for myself!
It makes no difference! Not even Omega Supreme can stop me now!
I know what to do Soundwave.  Be silent or face my wrath!
Yes...YES!
The Autobots' most powerful weapon...
AND the key to the core of Cybertron ARE MINE!
The universe shall hear my name and TREMBLE!
Power: failing...  Situation: critical...
Scanning: Decepticon intruders.  Weapons: engaging.
Power cells: drained.  Initiate: energy recovery subroutine.
Detected: system corruption.  Action: release counter-virus.

fra.text: Alerte : systèmes corrompus. Action : contre-virus initialisé.

int.text: Warning: vulnerability in select sub-systems.
Armor: weakened. Systems: recalibrating. Situation: sub-optimal.
Damage: critical... Iacon: threatened... Battle: unfinished...
Systems: failing... Defeat: unacceptable!
Orders: protect Iacon... Success: imperative!
Immediate surrender: required. Access to core: impossible.

fra.text: Capitulation immédiate : requise. Accès au noyau : interdit !

int.text: Systems: corrupted. Power level: 49%. Repairs: initiating.
Systems: failing. Corruption: total.

Danger! Avoid Omega Supreme's tractor beam! Seek cover before he fully charges it!
Scans indicate that Omega Supreme's defensive barrier does not extend to his turrets. Recommend targeting them immediately.
